axis_note: raster pixels of the sheet 5 scan, origin top-left, x right, y down; panel A depiction at page bottom-left of the divider rule, panel B depiction at page top-right of it

point_pairs.feature: SW corner (at Ave A east face) of the landward block front on the NORTH side of 22nd St
point_pairs.evidence: Panel A: '22ND ST.' printed in-band, corner where the stub front meets the Ave A face, x3565. Panel B: '22ND ST.' printed beside the stub, corner at x6380. Same drafted corner: block north of 22nd at Ave A.

point_pairs.feature: NW corner (at Ave A east face) of the landward block front on the SOUTH side of 22nd St
point_pairs.evidence: Corner where the south-side stub front meets the Ave A face on each panel, immediately south of the printed '22ND ST.' labels.

point_pairs.feature: West corner of the Pier 22 shed's landward (root) end wall (inner yellow rectangle, 'Galveston Wharf Co's Shed / Gulf Fishery Co. Lessee')
point_pairs.evidence: Panel A: shed carries the full lessee text ('...WHARF CO'S. SHED / ...ERY CO. LESSEE / NIGHT WATCHMAN REPORTS HOURLY TO TWO STATIONS') and 'PIER 22' label; panel B: 'PIER 22' label beside the same shed footprint with Slip to its east on both panels.

point_pairs.feature: East corner of the Pier 22 shed's landward (root) end wall
point_pairs.evidence: As P3. Shed end-wall length: panel A ~202 px, panel B ~210 px (agreement ~2.6 ft at 309 px/100 ft).

point_pairs.feature: West corner of the Pier 22 outer deck outline at the root end
point_pairs.evidence: Outer heavy pier outline. Panel A's corner is rounded/multi-segment (reads 2085-2107 depending on segment extension) - sigma inflated accordingly.

point_pairs.feature: East corner of the Pier 22 outer deck outline at the root end
point_pairs.evidence: Outer heavy pier outline; panel B's east side bends just above this corner.

consistency_check.internal_agreement: Within-group agreement is good: the two 22nd St pairs agree to (5, 2) px; the two shed pairs to (8, 10) px; the two deck pairs to (62, 15) px (deck corners are the weakest reads).
consistency_check.cross_group_disagreement: Between the street group and the pier group the translation differs by ~170 px in page-x and ~15 px in page-y (street pairs ~(2812,-6953), shed pairs ~(2644,-6936)). The two panels are therefore NOT related by pure translation for this duplicated ground: the pier root sits ~170 px (~55 ft at panel scale) closer to the Ave A frontage relative to 22nd St on panel A than on panel B, and the pier is drawn at a visibly different angle to the page on the two panels (panel A's depiction leans harder into the page corner). RECORDED AS DRAFTED DISAGREEMENT - do not reconcile; the fit should treat the 22nd St pairs (P1/P2) as the primary cross-panel constraint and the pier pairs as corroboration with their stated sigmas.
consistency_check.other_recorded_disagreements: Outer deck end-wall drafted length: panel A ~306 px vs panel B ~244 px (~20 ft) - panel A appears to include an apron/extension in the outer outline at the root that panel B does not; the inner shed end walls agree (~202 vs ~210 px).

notes: Panel break confirmed at 22nd St: panel A's landward column ends with 22nd (label at y~7200) and the plate's corner numeral '5' below; panel B begins with 22nd (label at y~200) at its top. Both panels carry their own 'Ave. A or Water' label and their own Slip east of Pier 22, as canon describes.
